name: no-key-free-benchmark-plan
scope: Evaluate god-search behavior when no paid API keys or credential-backed providers are available.

runner.credential_policy: Strip BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, REDDIT_CLIENT_ID, REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET, TAVILY_API_KEY, EXA_API_KEY, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, and SERPER_API_KEY from the default profile.
runner.brave_policy: Disable Brave in the default no-key profile so results reflect engines that can run without paid credentials.

docs.purpose: Official documentation retrieval for common developer tasks.

code.purpose: Repository and implementation discovery where GitHub-like results matter.

discussion.purpose: Forum-style searches where Reddit or community pages may be relevant.

factual.purpose: Stable fact lookups that expose whether the no-key profile can find direct authoritative sources.

general.purpose: Standards, guides, and practical web searches that reward primary or durable reference pages.

fairness_guardrails: Treat the offline fixture benchmark as a deterministic regression check, not a leaderboard claim.
Keep qrels shallow unless produced through blind pooled judging, and report judgment coverage.
Prefer stable primary or authoritative sources for grade 3 judgments.
Use grade 1 for related-but-weak pages that may be plausible but should not count as relevant.
Compare no-key results only against systems run in the same live benchmark snapshot.
